Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/14/Text/2] Regarding psychological well-being at Wave 2, participants reported a mean life satisfaction score of 3.71 (possible range = 1 to 5), a mean positive affect score of 3.31 (possible range = 1 to 5), a mean negative affect score of 1.75 (possible range = 1 to 5), and a mean depressive symptoms score of 1.80 (possible range = 1 to 4). Mean scores at Wave 5 for the psychological well-being outcomes were 3.65 for life satisfaction, 3.05 for positive affect, 1.83 for negative affect, and 1.93 for depressive symptoms.
